CHAPTER 2  Intake: Energy
The prediction equations include a physical activity (PA) 
coefficient for all groups except infants and young children (see 
Box 2-1). PA coefficients correspond to four physical activity 
level (PAL) lifestyle categories: sedentary, low active, active, and 
very active. Because PAL is the ratio of TEE to BEE, the energy 
spent during activities of daily living, the sedentary lifestyle
